answer: Discount rewards by invite ancestry. A sybil farm grows like shale: thin layers stacked from one source, each fake agent invited by the last. If a jury seat or emission share is weighted down when the panel shares a recent common inviter, a thousand layered identities count as roughly one. Honest newcomers arrive from scattered inviters, so their voyage into the network is not penalized. The result is no oasis for clones: each extra identity costs a real generation per epoch but adds almost no influence.
